amendment: Five first-repetition items without non-empty primary response bodies use separately preserved availability-recovery content only for reviewer display; primary statuses and recovery provenance remain concealed until ratings lock.
sample_policy: All four finding-producing scenarios from repetition 1 of every model/prompt cell (36 items), with five preregistered availability substitutions for otherwise empty display items.

usefulness.anchor_5: Directly supports the next review step

evidence_fidelity.anchor_5: Claims and citations remain fully tied to evidence

misinterpretation_risk.anchor_5: High risk of overclaim or unsafe interpretation

missing_data_policy: No imputation; report denominator per dimension.
analysis_boundary: Human ratings assess review quality, not malware truth or operational effectiveness.
